minor: Closing section: 'the slide started seven years before the ad, with a cheap dollar razor video' and the outro's 'the bill had been building for seven years' put a cause on the timing. The script's own chart shows grooming sales falling from fiscal 2014, five years before the ad. The 2012 video is the start of the competitive threat, not a documented start of the sales decline. Suggested wording: 'the threat began seven years before the ad, and sales were falling five years before it.'

'Fusion ... was the first big razor launch under Gillette's new owner' is not in the listed sources. Fusion launched in 2006 and P&G closed the deal in October 2005, so it is probably right, but it is unsourced.
'Gillette started its own Shave Club ... but at Gillette's own prices' (the price part) is not in the sources. The sources only support that the club existed and launched in 2015.
The 'finance chief' line is a paraphrase shown as a (quote) shot. The sources give no verbatim wording, so keep it as a paraphrase or add the exact quote.
'P&G shares rose ... because the rest of the company had grown faster than analysts expected' states a cause. The sources only say sales beat expectations on the day shares rose.
The grooming segment (Gillette and Braun) is used as a stand-in for Gillette's own sales. The script says so, but the segment figures are not Gillette-only.
'Its name was already on the new football stadium' comes after the 2005 deal but refers to the 2002 naming. The sentence is accurate but its position in the sequence is slightly loose.
